poster.title: GitHub Learning Initiative
poster.tagline: Learn GitHub from Scratch. Build Real Skills. Strengthen Your Resume.
poster.description: An exclusive learning initiative for girl students who are genuinely interested in learning GitHub through guided sessions and hands-on practice.

sections.heading: Why Join?
items: Resume enhancement for internships and placements
Build confidence using GitHub for projects

sections.heading: Who Can Join?
sections.content: Girl students who are genuinely interested in learning GitHub. No prior GitHub experience is required.

certificate.title: Certificate of Participation/Completion
certificate.description: Awarded to students who successfully complete the learning initiative and actively participate in the sessions.

faqs.question: Who can participate?
faqs.answer: Girl students who are interested in learning GitHub and improving their technical skills.

faqs.question: Do I need prior GitHub experience?
Is there any registration fee?
faqs.answer: Free to participate. There is no registration fee.

faqs.question: Will I receive a certificate?
faqs.answer: Yes. A Certificate of Participation/Completion will be awarded to students who successfully complete the initiative and actively participate in the sessions.

faqs.question: What do I need to join?
How will the sessions be conducted?
faqs.answer: Sessions will be conducted online with guided demonstrations and hands-on practice.

faqs.question: What is the duration of the initiative?
faqs.answer: Duration and schedule will be shared with registered participants.

faqs.question: Will there be practical assignments?
faqs.answer: Yes. Participants will complete hands-on exercises and GitHub activities throughout the initiative.
